fact: The August 2025 project paper says RESUC, with 198,140 households covered by July 2025, is a foundation for integrating social protection programmes, that safety net beneficiary data is being incorporated into the registry, and that the project is scaling a digital payment system with 9,337 beneficiaries paid digitally.
title: Project Paper on a Proposed Additional Credit to the Republic of Cameroon for the Adaptive Safety Nets and Economic Inclusion Project
